selection_semantics: Role templates must bind actual instance IDs. Reference actions are not observed outcomes.

interfaces.contact_region: carrier structural handles and dock latch
interfaces.tool_role: parallel gripper and dock latch tool
interfaces.support_transition: source support -> closed carrier -> destination support
interfaces.preserve: Do not lift by film, optical face, track or sensor lead
interfaces.recovery: Reseat on last observed support before retrying the latch or grasp
interfaces.remaining: Carrier handles, retention latches and station docks have no modeled fixture.

interfaces.target_role: stock, storage compartment and labeled tray
interfaces.contact_region: compartment handle and stock edges
interfaces.tool_role: gripper, sheet support or film frame
interfaces.support_transition: stock rack -> retained tray
interfaces.preserve: Separate accepted, unused and rejected stock
interfaces.recovery: Return identified stock to a supported slot and reconcile count
interfaces.remaining: Stock rack, trays, unfinished blanks and replacement inventory need geometry.

interfaces.target_role: stock blank, cutter and cutting fixture
interfaces.contact_region: blank clamp lands and tool work origin
interfaces.tool_role: clamp driver, selected cutter and edge-finishing tool
interfaces.support_transition: blank retained in fixture -> cut part retained -> labeled carrier
interfaces.preserve: Keep clamps clear of cut and retain the offcut independently
interfaces.recovery: Stop the tool, inspect restraint, replace damaged stock under a new identity
interfaces.remaining: Selected cutting machines, stock fixtures, cutting paths and finishing tools need geometry; map recesses are a thermal-path-changing hypothesis.

interfaces.contact_region: job selection, start and stop controls
interfaces.tool_role: button tool or authorized device interface
interfaces.support_transition: stock remains clamped throughout machine motion
interfaces.preserve: Controller acknowledgment is not proof of completed cutting
interfaces.recovery: Request stop and verify stopped state before access
interfaces.remaining: Water-jet model and actual control interface are unselected.

interfaces.target_role: emitter, masking, paint can and cap
interfaces.contact_region: disk backside/edge, mask margin and nozzle actuator
interfaces.tool_role: edge fixture, masking tool and spray-can gripper
interfaces.support_transition: emitter remains on coating support during every coat and cure
interfaces.preserve: Protect optical face from gripper contact; retain the paint identity
interfaces.recovery: Release nozzle, retain disk and inspect coat before rework or replacement
interfaces.remaining: Spray can/nozzle, masking, coating support and compatible surface-preparation tools need geometry.

interfaces.contact_region: base underside, frame fasteners and foam rim
interfaces.support_transition: bench fixture -> fastened base -> supported insulation stack
interfaces.preserve: Do not compress foam using an unqualified clamp load
interfaces.recovery: Support loose components, undo the affected connection and inspect seating
